newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's approves plan on state pensions growth.
newsitem.headline: Spain's approves plan on state pensions growth.

text.p: The Spanish cabinet approved on Friday a bill guaranteeing the purchasing power and future payment of state workers' pensions.
"For the first time an increase in pensions in line with the consumer price index will be regulated in a permanent form," the Employment and Social Affairs Ministry said in a statement.
The conservative government's decision followed a deal struck with trade unions assuring that state pensions would rise in line with inflation until the year 2000.
But the government remains at odds with the unions over plans to freeze state workers' salaries in 1997 and unions have called a strike for December 11.
